name: How long does a typical sliding door frame replacement project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical sliding door frame replacement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical sliding door frame replacement project can usually be completed within one to two days, depending on the complexity of the existing installation and any necessary structural adjustments. This timeframe includes removal of the old door and frame, preparation of the opening, installation of the new frame and door, and finishing work. Custom orders or unexpected structural repairs can extend the project duration. We aim to minimize disruption to your home during the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical sliding door frame replacement takes one to two days, depending on complexity and structural needs. This includes removal, installation, and finishing.
